pairs.subject: document-text-extraction
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/simulator/data.ts:4 The simulator page only reads typed tournament, run and transcript rows from the daemon over the shared contract and never takes in an uploaded byte container. A case-insensitive search of its files for pdf, ocr, docx, unreadable and extract found nothing, and no package.json in the repo declares pdf-parse, pdfjs, tesseract or mammoth, so the subject's precondition (turning documents into text) does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/simulator/data.ts:31 The data layer folds paged daemon rows into tiles. No document regions exist that could be unreadable.
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/quote.ts:23 The quote check matches a judge quote against structured transcript events. It is not a yield measure over extracted document text.
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/quote.ts:9 Strings are only folded for matching. The page has no converter that emits Markdown or other markup from document text.
apps/console/src/pages/simulator/data.ts:9 The only cap here is the daemon's page size. No container reader with repeat or reference constructs exists in this context.
